svg.text: Seven single-responsibility agents hand one shared RepairContext down a self-correcting chain, backed by a tool layer — numbers are deterministic, only prose is LLM-generated
DATA — 50 YEARS OF FORD WARRANTY CLAIMS
cross-system join on masked VIN + repair date
member claims per Repair Signature — 71,957 signatures (vehicle line × causal part × symptom archetype)
SRC/AGENTS — SEVEN-AGENT HAND-OFF CHAIN + SELF-CORRECTING QA LOOP
Orchestrator — run_one(signature, state) live · run_batch() concurrent + resumable
revision request — text defects only, bounded to ONE round
each agent reads upstream fields and writes its own — the same object is handed off, never re-derived
OUTPUT — ONE LIBRARY, TWO BUSINESS OUTCOMES + THE PRODUCT INFERENCE PATH
diagnosis · correction · labor · cost · parts · confidence
keeps future claims clean at the point of filing
retrieval first · LLM only to disambiguate
candidate Canonical Repairs (the library is the retrieval index)
SRC/TOOLS — THE TOOL LAYER (AGENTS SELECT TOOLS; NEVER CALL APIS DIRECTLY)
every external call: 60s timeout · retry/back-off · auth refresh · graceful fallback
✓ 99 offline tests (96% coverage) + CI — every cloud call mocked
✓ ran at scale — 3,623/3,623 LLM calls completed (transient failures retried)
✓ auditable — numbers are deterministic; the LLM writes prose only
